points.title: 成长与求学
points.description: 伊本·白图泰出生于摩洛哥的丹吉尔，一个当时受马林王朝统治的城市。他来自一个柏柏尔裔的伊斯兰法学家庭，从小接受传统的伊斯兰教育。在丹吉尔，他学习了古兰经、伊斯兰法学和文学，为日后的旅行奠定了知识基础。21岁时，他完成了学业，成为一名马利克派法学学者，并萌生了前往麦加朝圣的愿望。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Tangier, Morocco, then under Marinid rule, Ibn Battuta came from a Berber family of Islamic legal scholars. In Tangier, he received traditional Islamic education, studying the Quran, Maliki jurisprudence, and literature. By age 21, he completed his education as a Maliki scholar and developed a desire to undertake the Hajj pilgrimage to Mecca.

points.title: 首次朝圣与东方之旅
points.description: 1325年，伊本·白图泰开始了他的首次朝圣之旅。他选择了一条陆路路线，穿越北非、埃及、叙利亚和阿拉伯半岛，历时一年多到达麦加。完成朝圣后，他并未立即返回，而是继续向东旅行，前往波斯、伊拉克和阿富汗。在此期间，他访问了当时蒙古伊儿汗国的首都大不里士，并探索了波斯湾地区。这段旅程极大地开阔了他的视野，也激发了他继续探索世界的决心。
points.descriptionEn: In 1325, Ibn Battuta began his first pilgrimage journey. He chose a land route through North Africa, Egypt, Syria, and the Arabian Peninsula, taking over a year to reach Mecca. After completing the Hajj, he continued eastward, traveling to Persia, Iraq, and Afghanistan. During this period, he visited Tabriz, the capital of the Ilkhanate, and explored the Persian Gulf region. This journey greatly broadened his horizons and strengthened his resolve to explore the world.

points.title: 南亚之旅与仕途
points.titleEn: South Asian Journey and Official Career
points.description: 从麦加返回途中，伊本·白图泰决定前往印度。他经波斯湾到达印度，在德里苏丹国穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克的宫廷中获得了法官的职位。他在印度任职约八年，期间游历了印度次大陆的大部分地区。1342年，他被派往中国，但在途中遭遇海难，漂流至马尔代夫。他在马尔代夫停留了近两年，甚至成为该国的首席法官。这段经历使他深入了解了南亚和印度洋地区的政治、文化和经济状况。
points.descriptionEn: On his return from Mecca, Ibn Battuta decided to travel to India. He reached India via the Persian Gulf and obtained a position as a judge at the court of Muhammad bin Tughluq of the Delhi Sultanate. He served in India for about eight years, traveling extensively across the Indian subcontinent. In 1342, he was sent on a mission to China but was shipwrecked and drifted to the Maldives, where he stayed for nearly two years and even became the chief judge. This experience provided him with deep insights into the political, cultural, and economic conditions of South Asia and the Indian Ocean region.

points.title: 东方远行
points.description: 离开马尔代夫后，伊本·白图泰继续他的东方之旅，前往东南亚。他访问了苏门答腊、爪哇和马来半岛等地区，记录了这些地方的政治、贸易和宗教状况。随后，他试图前往中国，经过越南、菲律宾等地，最终到达元朝的首都大都（今北京）。他在中国停留了约一年，游历了多个城市，包括杭州、广州和泉州。这段旅程使他成为历史上少数几位完整记录了14世纪东南亚和中国状况的旅行家之一。
points.descriptionEn: After leaving the Maldives, Ibn Battuta continued his eastern journey, traveling to Southeast Asia. He visited Sumatra, Java, and the Malay Peninsula, documenting the political, trade, and religious conditions of these regions. He then attempted to reach China, passing through Vietnam, the Philippines, and eventually reaching Dadu (modern Beijing), the capital of the Yuan Dynasty. He stayed in China for about a year, visiting cities including Hangzhou, Guangzhou, and Quanzhou. This journey made him one of the few travelers to comprehensively document the conditions of 14th-century Southeast Asia and China.

points.title: 西行归途
points.description: 从中国返回的旅程同样漫长而曲折。伊本·白图泰经中亚、波斯和阿拉伯半岛返回北非。途中，他访问了当时由纳斯里德王朝统治的格拉纳达，成为历史上少数几位访问过中世纪西班牙的穆斯林旅行家之一。1354年，他终于回到了摩洛哥的非斯。这次西行归途使他完成了几乎整个伊斯兰世界的旅行，成为当时最伟大的旅行家之一。
points.descriptionEn: The return journey from China was equally long and arduous. Ibn Battuta traveled back through Central Asia, Persia, and the Arabian Peninsula to North Africa. Along the way, he visited Granada, then under the Nasrid dynasty, becoming one of the few Muslim travelers to visit medieval Spain. In 1354, he finally returned to Fez in Morocco. This western return journey completed his travels across almost the entire Islamic world, establishing him as one of the greatest travelers of his time.

points.title: 晚年著述
points.description: 回到摩洛哥后，伊本·白图泰受到了摩洛哥苏丹的关注。1355年，苏丹命令他口述旅行经历，由宫廷书记官伊本·朱扎伊记录整理。这些记录后来被整理成《伊本·白图泰游记》，成为研究14世纪世界历史、地理和文化的重要文献。晚年，伊本·白图泰继续在摩洛哥的马拉喀什和马拉喀什等地生活，直到1369年去世。他的游记被翻译成多种语言，对后世的世界观和地理探索产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to Morocco, Ibn Battuta caught the attention of the Moroccan Sultan. In 1355, the Sultan ordered him to dictate his travel experiences, which were recorded by the court scribe Ibn Juzayy. These records were later compiled into 'The Rihla' (The Journey), becoming an important source for studying the history, geography, and culture of the 14th century. In his later years, he continued to live in Moroccan cities like Marrakech until his death in 1369. His travelogue was translated into multiple languages and had a profound influence on subsequent worldviews and geographical exploration.

supporter.zh: 伊本·白图泰被誉为中世纪最伟大的旅行家之一，他的足迹遍布当时已知世界的几乎所有伊斯兰国家和地区。支持者认为他不仅是一位勇敢的探险家，更是一位敏锐的观察者和记录者。他的《伊本·白图泰游记》为后人提供了14世纪世界各地的珍贵历史资料，包括政治制度、社会习俗、商业贸易和宗教状况。他的旅行精神和对知识的追求，体现了伊斯兰文明开放包容的传统，激励了后世无数探险家和学者。
supporter.en: Ibn Battuta is celebrated as one of the greatest travelers of the Middle Ages, whose足迹 spanned nearly every Islamic region and country of the known world. Supporters view him not only as a brave explorer but also as a keen observer and recorder. His 'Rihla' provides invaluable historical information about 14th-century societies, including political systems, social customs, commerce, and religious practices. His spirit of adventure and pursuit of knowledge exemplifies the open and inclusive tradition of Islamic civilization, inspiring countless explorers and scholars throughout history.

critic.zh: 批评者指出伊本·白图泰的游记中存在夸大和虚构的成分，部分描述缺乏准确性。他有时会混淆地名或事件，甚至可能借鉴了其他旅行家的记述。此外，他对一些非伊斯兰文明的描述带有偏见，尤其是对印度和中国文化的理解存在局限。他的社会地位（多次担任法官和官员）也使他的观察可能受到阶级视角的影响，无法完全代表普通人的经历。这些批评提醒我们，即使是伟大的旅行家，其记录也需要谨慎对待和批判性分析。
critic.en: Critics point out that Ibn Battuta's accounts contain exaggerations and fabrications, with some descriptions lacking accuracy. He sometimes confused places or events and may have incorporated accounts from other travelers. Additionally, his descriptions of non-Islamic civilizations often carry biases, particularly in his limited understanding of Indian and Chinese cultures. His social status (having served as judge and official multiple times) also means his observations may be influenced by a class perspective, failing to fully represent ordinary people's experiences. These criticisms remind us that even great travelers' accounts require careful handling and critical analysis.

objective.zh: 从历史学和流行文化视角看，伊本·白图泰被视为连接中世纪东西方文明的重要桥梁。他的游记不仅是个人冒险的记录，更是14世纪全球化早期阶段的珍贵见证。在历史学界，他的著作被用作研究当时社会、经济和宗教的重要史料，同时也被用来分析中世纪穆斯林的世界观。在流行文化中，他常被比作'中世纪的马可·波罗'，象征着人类探索未知的永恒精神。他的故事被改编成书籍、纪录片和电视剧，成为跨文化交流的象征，激励着当代人们对世界的好奇心和探索精神。
objective.en: From historical and cultural perspectives, Ibn Battuta is regarded as an important bridge connecting medieval Eastern and Western civilizations. His travelogue is not merely a record of personal adventure but a valuable witness to the early stages of globalization in the 14th century. In historical scholarship, his work serves as crucial source material for studying contemporary societies, economies, and religions, as well as for analyzing medieval Muslim worldviews. In popular culture, he is often compared to 'the Marco Polo of the Middle Ages,' symbolizing humanity's eternal spirit of exploration. His story has been adapted into books, documentaries, and TV series, becoming a symbol of cross-cultural exchange and inspiring contemporary curiosity about the world.

self.zh: 旅行使青年人成长，使老年人年轻，使富人贫穷，使穷人富有。
self.en: Traveling in youth is a part of education; traveling in age is a part of experience.

others.zh: 伊本·白图泰是中世纪最伟大的旅行家，他的足迹比马可·波罗更远，记录更详尽。
others.en: Ibn Battuta was the greatest traveler of the Middle Ages, whose journeys were more extensive and whose accounts were more detailed than those of Marco Polo.
